activities.name: Vault of Glass
activities.description: Venture deep into the Vault of Glass and stop the Vex from mastering the fabric of time itself, ending with the time-bending mind Atheon.

activities.name: Deep Stone Crypt
activities.description: Descend into the Deep Stone Crypt beneath Europa's ice to stop the House of Salvation and the Fallen mercenary Taniks.

activities.name: Garden of Salvation
activities.description: Follow the Unraveler's trail into the Black Garden and sever the Vex's connection to the Darkness within the Consecrated Mind.

activities.name: Last Wish
activities.description: Confront Riven of a Thousand Voices, the last known Ahamkara, deep within the Dreaming City to break Queen Mara Sov's curse.

activities.name: Vow of the Disciple
activities.description: Breach the sunken pyramid in Savathûn's Throne World and end the Disciple of the Witness, Rhulk.

activities.name: King's Fall
activities.description: Board the Dreadnaught and slay Oryx, the Taken King, in this returning classic raid.

activities.name: Root of Nightmares
activities.description: Board the Essence and stop Nezarec, the Final God of Pain, from awakening aboard the derelict Pyramid ship.

activities.name: Crota's End
activities.description: Descend into the Hellmouth and end Crota, Son of Oryx, in this returning Destiny classic raid.

activities.name: Salvation's Edge
activities.description: Enter the Witness's monolith within the Pale Heart of the Traveler and stop the Final Shape.

activities.name: The Shattered Throne
activities.description: Delve into the Ascendant Plane to defeat Dûl Incaru and weaken the curse of the Dreaming City.

activities.name: Pit of Heresy
activities.description: Descend into the Scarlet Keep's depths and destroy the Hive god of death's chosen, Zulmak.

activities.name: Prophecy
activities.description: Journey into the realm of the Nine to restore balance between Light and Darkness.

activities.name: Grasp of Avarice
activities.description: Follow the trail of Fallen greed into the Loot Cave and claim the wealth of Wilhelm-7 — and Gjallarhorn.

activities.name: Duality
activities.description: Enter Emperor Calus's mind aboard the Leviathan and confront the Nightmares that haunt him.

activities.name: Spire of the Watcher
activities.description: Climb the Seraph spire on Mars and stop the rogue Warmind subroutine Persys.

activities.name: Ghosts of the Deep
activities.description: Dive beneath Titan's methane sea to end Savathûn's lingering Hive and the worm god's chosen.

activities.name: Warlord's Ruin
activities.description: Break the curse of the warlord Fikrul and end Rathil's dark ritual in this frozen keep.

encounters.name: Hefnd's Vengeance
encounters.boss: Hefnd's Vengeance, Locus of Wailing Grief

activities.name: Vesper's Host
activities.description: Board the derelict Seraph station overrun by the Scorn and recover the reforged Ice Breaker.

activities.name: Sundered Doctrine
activities.description: Decode the Witness's final secrets within the Rectifier and confront what remains of its doctrine.

656307180.name: Prime Zealot Mask
656307180.flavor: Forged from the cores of Hezen Vex. If you feel a sense of revelation, remove immediately and inject antientheogens.

4105572261.name: Prime Zealot Gloves
4105572261.flavor: Forged from the remnants of broken Vex. Some of the component matter is older than the solar system.

2245093627.name: Prime Zealot Cuirass
2245093627.flavor: Forged from the ruin of Hezen Vex armor. The sensory interface feels more natural than bare skin.

157934631.name: Prime Zealot Strides
157934631.flavor: Skinned in the membranes of the Hezen Vex. There is very little risk they will become permanently attached to your body.

695173568.name: Kabr's Battlecage
695173568.flavor: Kabr fought the Vex alone. But somehow they didn't kill him.

2556214161.name: Kabr's Brazen Grips
2556214161.flavor: He consumed their technology like fire, fashioning armor from their remnants.

3352305223.name: Kabr's Wrath
3352305223.flavor: In the aftermath, he became obsessed with the machines.

1962906467.name: Kabr's Forceful Greaves
1962906467.flavor: He was claimed by the Vault. His armor and myth are all that remain.

4067802966.name: Light of the Great Prism
4067802966.flavor: "When the long dark closes around us, we will be the last light." —Wei Ning

3091179819.name: Facade of the Hezen Lords
3091179819.flavor: The helm's nerve interface incorporates Vex cells. They're dead, of course. But not too dead to dream…

1371860250.name: Gloves of the Hezen Lords
1371860250.flavor: "Capable gauntlets. Extremely effective. I have only one piece of advice: never touch a living Vex."

3391112046.name: Cuirass of the Hezen Lords
3391112046.flavor: "Slept in the armor last night. Woke to feel my heart stuttering to the pattern of an unknown signal."

3094263124.name: Tread of the Hezen Lords
3094263124.flavor: Rumor has it that the exile Osiris came too close to understanding the Vex.

4133560887.name: Fragment of the Prime
4133560887.flavor: Caged in ascendant motes, it still glimmers with the light of some ceaseless calculation.

4289226715.name: Vex Mythoclast
4289226715.flavor: …a causal loop within the weapon's mechanism, suggesting that the firing process somehow binds space and time into…

3572161646.name: Legacy's Oath Mask
3572161646.flavor: "It's not just what I'm capable of. It's how I use it that makes the difference." —Ada-1

726855135.name: Legacy's Oath Grips
726855135.flavor: "Certainty is our greatest asset. Without it, we're nothing but shots in the dark." —Lakshmi-2

1657654553.name: Legacy's Oath Vest
1657654553.flavor: "Every day is a recommitment to my path." —Elsie Bray

3943072673.name: Legacy's Oath Strides
3943072673.flavor: "I'm more interested in where I'm going." —Banshee-44

3013397204.name: Legacy's Oath Cloak
3013397204.flavor: "How would one such as myself commit Human error when I am no longer Human?" —Hari-5

129329474.name: Legacy's Oath Helm
129329474.flavor: "Life's all about timing. You gotta know when to pull the trigger, when to go in for the kiss, and—most of all—when to make for the exit." —Cayde-6

3763941291.name: Legacy's Oath Gauntlets
3763941291.flavor: "My path is my own. Now, and forever." —Shiro-4

3046896869.name: Legacy's Oath Plate
3046896869.flavor: "What is necessary and what is right are not the same. All that matters is whichever serves you best." —Lisbon-13

943612349.name: Legacy's Oath Greaves
943612349.flavor: "I've traveled far and weathered much. How far and how much, I don't know. All I know is I'm not done yet." —Micah-10

1702811704.name: Legacy's Oath Mark
1702811704.flavor: "I know who I am. I am a Titan. So long as I am able, I stand between the Last City and those who would tear it down." —Saint-14

4191732605.name: Legacy's Oath Cowl
4191732605.flavor: "Sylvie is a stain on this family, turning my son against me every chance she gets. His death is on her hands too." —Clovis Bray I

2654264556.name: Legacy's Oath Gloves
2654264556.flavor: "Wilhelmina's more like me than she admits. Immortality at any cost. Even family." —Clovis Bray I

3001197620.name: Legacy's Oath Robes
3001197620.flavor: "Useless, that boy is. Nothing I altered in Alton's genetics paid off. Oh well. That's why I have three other grandchildren." —Clovis Bray I

3299996694.name: Legacy's Oath Boots
3299996694.flavor: "My dear, sweet Lusia. You were meant to be next to me in this life, and the next. There's time yet for me to make it so." —Clovis Bray I

4210958601.name: Legacy's Oath Bond
4210958601.flavor: "Anastasia's obsession with Rasputin is holding back our work. Exos are our future. In time—and with a little push—she'll see." —Clovis Bray I

2399110176.name: Eyes of Tomorrow
2399110176.flavor: "I want to see it all, unhindered, and know it's mine to take." —Clovis Bray

968831388.flavor: "You have the hands of an artist. Fortunately for us, one of those arts is war." —Lisbon-13, Hunter of the Kentarch 3

1078817668.name: Vest of Transcendence
1078817668.flavor: "If you do this, it can't be undone. Some choices change you. This is one of them." —Lisbon-13, Hunter of the Kentarch 3

4266726694.name: Strides of Ascendancy
4266726694.flavor: "You said we'd dance through time—reel through realities—together. You can't stop now." —Lisbon-13, Hunter of the Kentarch 3

1822544601.name: Cloak of Temptation
1822544601.flavor: "What is it you want? What is this really about?" —Lisbon-13, Hunter of the Kentarch 3

3218395433.name: Helm of Righteousness
3218395433.flavor: "I know what needs to done. And I'm the one to do it." —Yardarm-4, Titan of the Kentarch 3

1009804448.name: Gauntlets of Exaltation
1009804448.flavor: "Did you see that? Do you see what I can do?" —Yardarm-4, Titan of the Kentarch 3

1743776488.name: Plate of Transcendence
1743776488.flavor: "The Vex can't stop us now. No one can."  —Yardarm-4, Titan of the Kentarch 3

3999711322.name: Greaves of Ascendancy
3999711322.flavor: "I know where I stand." —Yardarm-4, Titan of the Kentarch 3

3445873861.name: Temptation's Mark

1138770162.name: Mask of Righteousness

1563546587.name: Gloves of Exaltation
1563546587.flavor: "You're honest. You're true. If anyone can handle the responsibility of this power, it's you." —Rekkana, Warlock of the Kentarch 3

440521013.name: Robes of Transcendence
440521013.flavor: "Do you think this makes you better than us?" —Rekkana, Warlock of the Kentarch 3

13586765.name: Boots of Ascendancy
13586765.flavor: "I've chosen my path. Can you say the same?" —Rekkana, Warlock of the Kentarch 3

3433082888.name: Temptation's Bond
3433082888.flavor: "You said you'd always trust me. Trust me." —Rekkana, Warlock of the Kentarch 3

2209003210.name: Zealot's Reward

4103414242.flavor: Calibrate reality. Seek inevitability. Embody divinity.

2069224589.name: One Thousand Voices
2069224589.flavor: I can be anyone you wish, o murderer mine.

4094657108.name: Techeun Force
4094657108.flavor: Sworn into faithful service to the Queen, the Techeuns of the Reef have long protected the secrets of the Awoken.

686951703.name: The Supremacy
686951703.flavor: "He didn't recognize me, at the end." —Jolyon Till the Rachis

601592879.name: Age-Old Bond
601592879.flavor: Symbiosis. Not predation. Never predation, o wary one mine.

654370424.name: Nation of Beasts
654370424.flavor: I can show you how we were in our prime. You need only ask, o student mine.

568515759.name: Chattering Bone
568515759.flavor: We have so much to discuss, o seeker mine.

3799980700.name: Transfiguration
3799980700.flavor: Desire becomes reality, o wishbringer mine.

2545083870.name: Apex Predator
2545083870.flavor: Is it you or I that tops the food chain, o challenger mine?

3300005657.name: Resonant Fury Mask
3300005657.flavor: I see the void, and through this gaze, I learn to covet no goal.

2771790736.name: Resonant Fury Grips
2771790736.flavor: I touch the void, and through this clasp, I learn to hold nothing.

4246884536.name: Resonant Fury Vest
4246884536.flavor: I feel the void, and through this experience, I learn that want is suffering.

3130426090.name: Resonant Fury Strides
3130426090.flavor: I walk the void, and through this journey, I learn that no place shall embrace me.

2642378837.name: Resonant Fury Cloak
2642378837.flavor: I wear the void, and through this empathy, I learn that only my will endures.

680713005.name: Resonant Fury Helm
680713005.flavor: Ur yearns for nurture. It does so through hunger.

1333378716.name: Resonant Fury Gauntlets
1333378716.flavor: Yul yearns for nurture. It does so through honesty.

1962502788.name: Resonant Fury Plate
1962502788.flavor: Xol yearned for nurture. It did so amongst the thousands.

336306726.name: Resonant Fury Greaves
336306726.flavor: Akka yearned for nurture. It did so through secrets.

2706229721.name: Resonant Fury Mark
2706229721.flavor: Eir yearns for nurture. It does so through order.

2504952530.name: Resonant Fury Cowl
2504952530.flavor: I see the task before me. I wear it with devotion.

2971305787.name: Resonant Fury Gloves
2971305787.flavor: I see the game. I raise the stakes.

1461764245.name: Resonant Fury Robes
1461764245.flavor: I reach for solace. It is stolen from me.

1379769261.name: Resonant Fury Boots
1379769261.flavor: I sought relief. I found delight.

159255784.name: Resonant Fury Bond
159255784.flavor: I reach for nothing. I am subdued. I shall remain useless.

3505113722.name: Collective Obligation
3505113722.flavor: "What The Witness gave me, I give to you. May it serve you in death, or in finality. It cannot be both." —Rhulk, disciple of the Witness

2892249111.name: Darkhollow Mask
2892249111.flavor: "The Dreadnaught is a blighted hollow gouged into our universe." ―Eris Morn

1965763230.name: Darkhollow Grasps
1965763230.flavor: "All the vastness of our universe is but a blank page on which they scrawl their words of hate and death." ―Eris Morn

402458066.name: Darkhollow Chiton
402458066.flavor: "Heartless and cruel is their realm—but in some ways more malleable than your own." —Eris Morn

2385145720.name: Darkhollow Treads
2385145720.flavor: "Even now, the daughters of Oryx weave black words of blight to bind his realm to ours." —Eris Morn

1039275747.name: Darkhollow Mantle
1039275747.flavor: "To even exist in their space is to constantly demand your own existence." —Eris Morn

1265664091.name: War Numen's Crown
1265664091.flavor: Show them you can contain multitudes, and your interiority will spawn nightmares.

2766419210.name: War Numen's Fist
2766419210.flavor: "The start is always the same. Enter his court, and call him out."

804869182.name: War Numen's Chest
804869182.flavor: "Death is the game, and the game is always death."

1805631268.name: War Numen's Boots
1805631268.flavor: "Speak, and the Darkness obeys. Command, and the song turns on itself."

558850503.name: War Numen's Mark
558850503.flavor: Will you barter your soul in exchange for the chance to kill a king?

662286992.name: Mouth of Ur
662286992.flavor: For the more Light the worms consume, the hungrier they become.

418390881.name: Grasp of Eir
418390881.flavor: At the beginning, they stood in thrall of the Formless One, and they offered themselves to its depth.

3912717495.name: Chasm of Yul
3912717495.flavor: A clew of writhing things there was also, on that cusp between Light and Darkness.

1913339475.name: Path of Xol
1913339475.flavor: Bound together, their power knows no limit, save their thirst for more.

1746069510.name: Bond of the Wormlore
1746069510.flavor: "They were two once. In the Darkness, they joined. Such is the Hive's strength. And such is their hunger." —Eris Morn

1802135586.name: Touch of Malice
1802135586.flavor: "Let them feel every lash, every curse, every touch of malice that they first dealt to me." —Eris Morn

3969066556.name: Midha's Reckoning
3969066556.flavor: "I see now that everything dies. Even… even memory." —Midha, Consort of Stars

3904516037.name: Midha's Reckoning (Harrowed)
3904516037.flavor: "…I will not be forgotten." —Midha, Consort of Stars

3228096719.name: Defiance of Yasmin
3228096719.flavor: "Shields up! Protect the queen! Brace for impact! Save the queen…" —Paladin Yasmin Eld

3503019618.name: Defiance of Yasmin (Harrowed)
3503019618.flavor: The impact is too great. Silence falls. The queen was safe… Please… let her be safe.

431721920.name: Zaouli's Bane
431721920.flavor: "Go, child! Run! Don't look back! Don't—"

291092617.name: Zaouli's Bane (Harrowed)
291092617.flavor: As the teeth rend and tear, my consolation is that the child lives.

2221264583.name: Smite of Merain
2221264583.flavor: "No tomb but the battlefield! No legacy but the scars we etch upon our foes!"

3407395594.name: Smite of Merain (Harrowed)
3407395594.flavor: Barrel etching: "He parted them like a sea, which closed upon him again."

1937552980.name: Doom of Chelchis
1937552980.flavor: "Where is the Great Machine? Where is the Great Machine?" —Chelchis, Kell of Stone

1184692845.name: Doom of Chelchis (Harrowed)
1184692845.flavor: "All is silent. Nothing answers me. The hunger comes." —Chelchis, Kell of Stone

1321506184.name: Qullim's Terminus
1321506184.flavor: "If only… if only we had heeded the queen…"

3371017761.name: Conditional Finality
3371017761.flavor: You will dream of me… I will never leave you…

135029084.name: Nessa's Oblation
135029084.flavor: "His influence doesn't end at his Fourth Tomb. I will find the rest… by any means necessary." —Nessa, Acolyte of Nezarec

522366885.name: Nessa's Oblation (Adept)
522366885.flavor: "His influence doesn't end at his Fourth Tomb. I will find the rest… by any means necessary." —Nessa, Acolyte of Nezarec

3493494807.name: Acasia's Dejection (Adept)
3493494807.flavor: Do not believe their lies. Run.

342514437.name: Rufus's Fury (Adept)
342514437.flavor: "For every round, a whisper. For every shell, a scream." —Rufus, Acolyte of Nezarec

495442100.flavor: "I cannot sleep. His gaze… it lingers at every corner of my mind." —Koraxis, Acolyte of Nezarec

2890082420.name: Briar's Contempt (Adept)
2890082420.flavor: "You will never be rid of him." —Briar, Acolyte of Nezarec

1232699955.name: Dogged Gage
1232699955.flavor: One doesn't need sleeves to keep knives inside them.

2781601117.name: Relentless Harness
2781601117.flavor: The splayed claws and empty skull of a Thrall cry defiance to the Hive.

967550725.name: Tireless Striders
967550725.flavor: If there is no road, then it cannot be long.

3936708974.name: Willbreaker's Watch
3936708974.flavor: Their howls of terror mark your arrival.

2541339673.name: Willbreaker's Resolve
2541339673.flavor: Their blades break against your heart.

12652705.name: Willbreaker's Greaves
12652705.flavor: The ground shudders beneath your feet.

3897082324.name: Mark of the Pit
